label: Company figure in money as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one amount of money as the company reported it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. The unit argument is the filed currency code (USD, EUR) and the figure is in that currency. Share counts are in company_fact_shares, amounts per share in company_fact_per_share, pure numbers in company_fact_ratio.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the XBRL element name exactly as filed (concept labels are in the dictionary)
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period: YYYY-MM-DD for an instant, or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD for a duration
args.unit: the filed currency code, such as USD or EUR (the figure is in that currency)

label: Company share count as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one number of shares as the company reported it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. The filed unit is shares; the unit of the value is count.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the XBRL element name exactly as filed (concept labels are in the dictionary)
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period: YYYY-MM-DD for an instant, or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD for a duration

label: Company amount per share as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one amount per share (such as earnings per share), filed in <currency>/shares, as the company reported it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. The currency argument is the currency code and the value is the amount of that currency per share. units.md has no rate whose per side is not a currency, so the declared unit is the currency and the per-share meaning is only this one (a spec gap, for the production review).

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the XBRL element name exactly as filed (concept labels are in the dictionary)
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period: YYYY-MM-DD for an instant, or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD for a duration
args.currency: the currency code of the filed <currency>/shares unit, such as USD (the value is the amount of that currency per share)

label: Company pure number as filed (XBRL fact, one filing)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one pure number (a ratio or a coefficient, filed unit pure) as the company reported it in one annual report (accession), exactly as filed: no scaling, no sign change, not normalised. A figure restated in a later annual report is a separate cell with that report's accession. Only 10-K and 10-K/A reports for fiscal years 2019 to 2024, and the listed concepts; each figure is one cell per filing and period. The unit of the value is 1.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.concept: the XBRL element name exactly as filed (concept labels are in the dictionary)
args.accession: the accession number of the filing, for example 0000320193-23-000106
args.period: YYYY-MM-DD for an instant, or YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD for a duration

label: Filing field (as filed)
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: one field of one annual report (accession), from the same companyfacts records, as filed; the period_end is the period end of the report's annual statements, not a cover-page date.

args.accession: the accession number of the filing
args.field: one of cik, form, filed, fy, fp, period_end

field.label: the fiscal year of the report, as filed (not the period's year)
the fiscal period of the report (FY)
the period end of the report's annual statements (not a cover-page date)

label: Latest annual report of a fiscal year
description: Relayed by datumesh.com from sec.gov: the accession of the latest-filed annual report (10-K or 10-K/A) of a company's fiscal year (fy as filed, not the period's year); a later amendment wins; a tie on the filing date goes to the higher accession. A fact about the filings, not a figure.

args.cik: the company's CIK, 10 digits with leading zeros
args.fiscal_year: the fiscal year as filed, a number such as 2023 (unit 1)
